name: Alaska Kenai + Anchorage Bookable Loop

dates.why: Aug 31-Sep 13 keeps Anchorage, Girdwood, Seward, Homer/Kachemak Bay, and Knik/Palmer in order without the prior over-budget remote-lodge default.

exchangeRateNote: Foreign-currency items use planning conversions and must be re-priced before booking.
positioning: Budget-rebalanced Alaska route: standard lodges and hotels by default, with Stillpoint and glacier flightseeing left as explicit upgrade options.
routeLabel: Anchorage → Girdwood → Seward → Homer/Halibut Cove → Knik
routeRationale: The route is ordered as Anchorage → Girdwood → Seward → Homer/Halibut Cove → Knik to reduce backtracking and keep the biggest transfers between lodging bases.
Each base lasts 2-4 nights so the baby has repeated sleep environments instead of daily hotel churn.
High-impact sights are paired with nearby backup options so weather does not break the trip.
The Ryan Shirley/video inspiration is used for idea generation, then validated with official tourism, park, hotel, airline, and activity sources.

budget.note: Reworked near target by replacing the remote lodge default with Homer/Knik practical stays. Stillpoint and flightseeing stay visible as upgrade choices.
